```artifact
Feature: Patient History File

  Scenario: Patient History File - For a patient, history of consultations done in last 3 years
    Given a patient with a history of consultations
    When I retrieve the patient's history of consultations
    Then the system should display the history of consultations done in the last 3 years

  Scenario: Patient Registration <= 4 seconds
    Given a patient registration request
    When I submit the patient registration request
    Then the system should respond within 4 seconds

  Scenario: Patient Consultation Requests <= 2 seconds
    Given a patient consultation request
    When I submit the patient consultation request
    Then the system should respond within 2 seconds

  Scenario: Chemist - Prescription Requests <= 2 seconds
    Given a chemist prescription request
    When I submit the chemist prescription request
    Then the system should respond within 2 seconds

  Scenario: Labs - Lab Requests <= 4 seconds
    Given a lab request
    When I submit the lab request
    Then the system should respond within 4 seconds

  Scenario: Patient - Prescription & Invoice Look-up <= 4 seconds
    Given a patient prescription and invoice lookup request
    When I submit the patient prescription and invoice lookup request
    Then the system should respond within 4 seconds

  Scenario Outline: System Scaling - At the peak, system should be able to scale to 10,000+ users (patients) concurrently
    Given <number> patients concurrently accessing the system
    When the system is under peak load
    Then the system should be able to handle the load without errors

    Examples:
      | number |
      | 10000  |
      | 10001  |
      | 10002  |

  Scenario Outline: Patient Registration - <= 4 seconds
    Given a patient registration request with <registration_time> seconds
    When I submit the patient registration request
    Then the system should respond within <registration_time> seconds

    Examples:
      | registration_time |
      | 0                |
      | 1                |
      | 4                |
      | 5                |

  Scenario Outline: Patient Consultation Requests - <= 2 seconds
    Given a patient consultation request with <consultation_time> seconds
    When I submit the patient consultation request
    Then the system should respond within <consultation_time> seconds

    Examples:
      | consultation_time |
      | 0                |
      | 1                |
      | 2                |
      | 3                |

  Scenario Outline: Chemist - Prescription Requests - <= 2 seconds
    Given a chemist prescription request with <prescription_time> seconds
    When I submit the chemist prescription request
    Then the system should respond within <prescription_time> seconds

    Examples:
      | prescription_time |
      | 0                |
      | 1                |
      | 2                |
      | 3                |

  Scenario Outline: Labs - Lab Requests - <= 4 seconds
    Given a lab request with <lab_time> seconds
    When I submit the lab request
    Then the system should respond within <lab_time> seconds

    Examples:
      | lab_time |
      | 0        |
      | 1        |
      | 4        |
      | 5        |

  Scenario Outline: Patient - Prescription & Invoice Look-up - <= 4 seconds
    Given a patient prescription and invoice lookup request with <lookup_time> seconds
    When I submit the patient prescription and invoice lookup request
    Then the system should respond within <lookup_time> seconds

    Examples:
      | lookup_time |
      | 0           |
      | 1           |
      | 4           |
      | 5           |
```
